comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To expand on those above posts by Elroy & Co., this item is part of the Footprints with Friends (No.1) Memorial Album. It can only be found by Pets in specific land and sea zones, and does not appear even in charted landing zone item lists.

If you wish to hunt it out for your MA, your best chance of finding it is to acquire both the Pet Training skill and a pet that has Area Search (Land) or Area Search (Sea), then spam Procurement/Collection; Additional Discovery and Pet Plunder (Land and/or Sea) can also work, but potentially at much a lower probability rate. Visit the Pet Training skill page for further details and links to some handy pet guides under the comment section.

I'm not sure about ocean zones (besides the Red Sea of course), but according to a JP blog you can find this particular Pet MA item using a Pet with Area Search (Land) skill at the following landing points:

· West Candia / Inland Crete
· Arabian Sea Northeast Coast / Sindh

Hope that helps. Cheers.

Effect: Enhance Cartography

How to obtain
1. Required Pet Skill: Area Search (Land)/Area Search (Sea)/Area Search (Land & Sea)
2. Recommended Title: Master Breeder
3. use Collection or Procurement skill in land/on sea and your pet will bring the item. (Collection skill is highly recommended)

Where to go
Land Area)
West Candia (Cross Grave) Inland Crete
Sindh Arabian Sea Northeast Coast (NE Upturned Boulder)

Sea Area)
Canary, Open Sea The Red Sea
